name: immersive_7_1_4
character: Discrete 7.1.4 immersive audio: the 7.1 ring plus four overhead loudspeakers, so height is a real channel and not a filter.
label: 7.1.4 immersive (ITU-R BS.2051 System J)
sources: ITU-R BS.2051-3: System J is the 7.1.4 loudspeaker layout (System H plus four overhead channels at +30 degrees)
ITU-R BS.1770-4: the LFE channel is excluded from the loudness measurement
The -3.0 dBTP ceiling is this project's delivery policy for a multichannel file that carries an LFE channel, not a measured acoustic value
